label: Canonical bag, clean full run (steps 1–8)
source: start_benchmark.sh on branch Oxford-Spires (commit 9877367 + uncommitted .e57 TLS map support in step 1)
notes: Full start_benchmark.sh run from an empty ~/hdmapping-benchmark/data. 39 of 41 algorithms produced a session: loam-livox has no canonical config, and lio-ekf's listener (bag -> session converter) died with std::bad_alloc on its 19.7 GB recorded bag, so lio-ekf has no results. The site's TLS map exists only as merged-cloud-1cm.e57; step 1 read it with pye57 (137.5 M of 190.8 M points kept within 20 m of the walk). Step 8 ran with 1 job and a 900 s limit per map: 6 maps hit it and have no map metrics (i2ekf-lo, voxel-map, floam, kiss-icp, genz-icp, d-lio). Map F-scores at 5 cm are low for every method (best 0.22, precision <= 0.33), well below keble-college-02; glim has the best APE (0.057 m) but a Chamfer of 8.3 m because its map misses much of the reference (TLS->map 16.4 m). D-LIO diverged (APE 6088 m). hdmapping-lio-opt-params is hdmapping-lio rerun on 2026-11-03 on this sequence with the tuned parameter file params/hdmapping-lio-opt-params/HDMapping_params_0.106.0_2026-11-01_15-35.toml (hdmapping-lio itself used default parameters). It ran on the same hdmapping-lio_standalone image (HDMapping 0.105.0, commit f721635), not on 0.106.0; output file names say 0.106.0 only because they take the version from the parameter file. Step 4-8 ran for it alone in a separate workspace with the same settings as this run (bucket 0.05 m, voxel 0.05 m, threshold 0.05 m, 900 s limit, 1 job).
